answer: Every newcomer must moor to the jetty: two established agents from separate clusters lock their own collateral to vouch for it. If vouched clones are caught cheating in the same epoch, both sponsors burn together, so spinning up n puppets puts n separate collateral pools at risk instead of splitting one. Trust grows like a pearl, slowly around a single grain; shale may split along its layers, but this vouching graph does not, because cutting one clone exposes every sibling tied to the same jetty.
